about: Shahan Ali, also known as ProBoy, itx_proboy, shahan315 and proboy315, is a full-stack developer, bot architect and Shopify expert from Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan.
He builds web applications, the ProBoy-MD WhatsApp bot, custom Shopify e-commerce, and AI integrations while studying ICS 1st Year at Govt Graduate College Burewala.

faq.a: Shahan Ali (ProBoy, shahan315, proboy315) is a full-stack, AI, bot and Shopify developer from Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. He studies ICS 1st Year at Govt Graduate College Burewala and builds web apps, the ProBoy-MD WhatsApp bot, and e-commerce stores.

faq.q: What services does Shahan Ali offer?
faq.a: Full-stack web engineering, Shopify Online Store 2.0 and Liquid customization, WhatsApp and bot automation, Gemini AI features, a JavaScript obfuscation tool, and creator analytics dashboards.

ProBoy-MD is a Node.js WhatsApp multi-device bot built with Baileys by Shahan Ali (ProBoy). It is command-based and includes automation, media utilities, group tools and developer utilities. Full notes are on the ProBoy-MD documentation page.

faq.q: Did Shahan Ali receive a Google Gemini QuizOff certificate?
faq.a: The portfolio shows a Certificate of Recognition for Google Gemini QuizOff 2026, organised by CampusCrew and hosted on Unstop, awarded to Shahan (Shahan Ali), dated 19 July 2026.
